Class Controller

java.lang.Object
Controller
public class Controller extends Object

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Runs the program, getting inputs and processing its outputs.

      Handles the Print, Input, Process loops for Main Menu, Overworld, and Dungeon depending on the current GameState. Ends processing once the game is no longer active from a Model.quit call.

    • processMenuInput

      private void processMenuInput()
      Processes player inputs in the Menu.

      It can Start a New Game, New Game Plus, or Continue a Game. It can also print the player's Status, a Help Manual, or Quit the game.

    • processOverworldInput

      private void processOverworldInput()
      Processes the player's inputs in the Overworld.

      It can start a Dungeon, open the Inventory, manage held Items, or save and quit the game.

    • processDungeonInput

      private void processDungeonInput()
      Processes the player's input in the Dungeon

      It can make the player manage and use Items or move around and interact with Structures, Creatures, or Loot in the Dungeon. Interactions are handled at the Floor.tick call.

      This also manages the output for either beating or dying in the Dungeon and sending the player back to the Overworld or Menu after.

    • startIntroSequence

      private void startIntroSequence()
      Calls the intro sequence in parts. Waits for a player input before showing the next part.

    • input

      private char input()
      Waits for the player to input into the console. Only grabs the first character of the input. If the Input is empty, it returns a space instead.
      Returns:
      a character representing the player's choice.

    • waitForContinue

      private void waitForContinue()
      Waits for the player to input anything into the console. Drops whatever input was accepted.
